```{r}
raw_data = read_csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

cleaned_data = raw_data %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  janitor::remove_empty(which = "rows") %>% # Specify 'rows' only
  janitor::remove_empty(which = "cols") %>% # Specify 'cols' only
  dplyr::distinct()

cleaned_data %>% drop_na()

summary(cleaned_data)
view(cleaned_data)
colnames(cleaned_data)

long_data = cleaned_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(avg_full_prof_salary, avg_assoc_prof_salary, avg_assist_prof_salary),
    names_to = "Rank",
    values_to = "Salary"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = case_when(
      Rank == "avg_full_prof_salary" ~ "Full",
      Rank == "avg_assoc_prof_salary" ~ "Assoc",
      Rank == "avg_assist_prof_salary" ~ "Assist",
      TRUE ~ Rank
    ),
    Rank = factor(Rank, levels = c("Assist", "Assoc", "Full")),
    tier = factor(tier, levels = c("I", "IIA", "IIB"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Salary, tier, Rank, state)

ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Rank, y = Salary, fill = Rank)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 2, width = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ tier, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(200, 1000, by = 200)) +
  labs(
    y = "Salary",
    fill = "Rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -1), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2)
  )

anova_model <- aov(Salary ~ state + tier + Rank, data = long_data)
view(long_data)

summary(anova_model)

chemical_compounds <- c(
  "alpha-pinene", "para-cymene", "alpha-terpineol", "cedr-9-ene", 
  "alpha-cedrene", "beta-cedrene", "cis-thujopsene", "alpha-himachalene", 
  "beta-chamigrene", "cuparene", "compound 1", "alpha-chamigrene", 
  "widdrol", "cedrol", "beta-acorenol", "alpha-acorenol", 
  "gamma-eudesmol", "beta-eudesmol", "alpha-eudesmol", "cedr-8-en-13-ol", 
  "cedr-8-en-15-ol", "compound 2", "thujopsenal"
)

juniper_raw = read_csv("Juniper_Oils.csv")

juniper_long = juniper_raw %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(chemical_compounds %>% janitor::make_clean_names()),
    names_to = "ChemicalID",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Concentration)

view(juniper_long)

ggplot(juniper_long, aes(x = years_since_burn, y = Concentration)) +
geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "orange", fill = "grey70") +
  labs(
    x = "Years Since Burn",
    y = "Concentration"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ ChemicalID, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

glm_model = glm(
  Concentration ~ ChemicalID * years_since_burn, 
  data = juniper_long, 
  family = gaussian()
)

model_output_tidy = tidy(glm_model)

significant_terms = model_output_tidy %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

print(significant_terms)

```
